title: Builderwand
description: A Minecraft/Paper plugin that adds upgradeable Builder Wands for placing, mining, and pathing blocks faster. It includes durability, repairs, crafting, and a simple GUI.
body:
BuilderWand 🪄🏗️
BuilderWand is a survival-friendly building plugin that makes construction faster, smoother, and way less repetitive. Instead of placing, mining, or shaping every single block by hand, players can use upgradeable wands to work across bigger areas while still using real resources from their inventory.

Build faster, mine smarter, and shape terrain without turning survival into creative mode. ✨

What It Does ⚒️
BuilderWand gives players magical building wands that can help with common building tasks like placing blocks, mining selected areas, and creating paths. The wand is designed to feel powerful, but still balanced for survival servers.

Players still need materials, tools, durability, repairs, and upgrades, so the plugin keeps progression and resource management alive.

Features 🌟
🪄 Upgradeable Builder Wands
🧱 Fast block placing
⛏️ Area mining with proper tools
🛤️ Path creation for dirt and grass
🔋 Wand durability system
🛠️ Repair system with level-based costs
⭐ Multiple wand tiers
🔓 Unlockable features by wand level
📦 Uses blocks from the player inventory
🧭 Simple in-game GUI
🧪 Custom crafting and upgrade flow
🧱 Survival-friendly building
🛡️ Does not break unbreakable blocks like bedrock
Why Use It? 💡
BuilderWand is perfect for players who love building but hate spending ages repeating the same small actions. It helps with walls, floors, roads, terraforming, clearing areas, and general base building while still keeping the server balanced.

It is especially useful for:

🏠 Survival servers
👥 SMP servers
💰 Economy servers
🏰 Towny / kingdom style servers
🧱 Builder-focused communities
⚙️ Progression-based gameplay
Balanced For Survival ⚖️
This plugin is not just a free building cheat. Players need to upgrade their wand, repair it when durability runs low, and provide the blocks or tools required for each action.

Higher tier wands are stronger, faster, and unlock more features, but they also cost more to repair and upgrade.

In-Game GUI 📋
BuilderWand includes a clean GUI where players can:

Upgrade their wand
Repair their wand
View recipes
Choose building actions
Craft the first wand
Craft upgrade items
Everything is easy to access without needing complicated commands.

Build More, Click Less 🚀
Whether you are building a huge base, digging out rooms, making roads, or shaping terrain, BuilderWand helps players spend less time on repetitive clicking and more time actually creating cool things.
